text:
Alex Soto: quick sync on adding throughput sparkline to the latency card — Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/throughput/latency-plus-throughput :eyes: Jules Park: saw it. clean. main concern: extra visual weight in the header when percentiles + throughput + heatmap all present Renee Cole: can we tuck throughput into a thin sparkline under the p95 value? small glyph, hover shows rps and 1m avg Marco Li: love that. accessibility question: should the sparkline be live-updating? screen readers could get noisy Alex Soto: idea: make sparkline aria-live polite and only announce on big deltas (>30%), otherwise provide numeric tooltip readout on focus Jules Park: also need colorblind-friendly palette for throughput vs heatmap. current blue+purple is hard for some users Renee Cole: propose using color pair: teal for throughput, warm gray for heatmap baseline, and a patterned overlay for high-intensity buckets so color alone isn't the only cue Marco Li: sampling control copy thought: replace "Sample density" with "Sampling granularity" and options: Dynamic (recommended) | Per-request | Windowed Alex Soto: 'Dynamic' communicates auto-adaptive behavior — plus a tooltip: "Dynamic: adjusts sampling to maintain latency SLOs while lowering cost" Jules Park: keyboard/navigation nit: when the sparkline receives focus it shows tooltip but shift+tab behavior collapses the timepicker; focus order needs to be linear Renee Cole: repro steps: tab into header, focus p95, tab to sparkline, Shift+Tab back, timepicker closes unexpectedly on Safari A11y Bot: Snapshot saved for 1732100000 — will include aria-live delta threshold and legend IDs Marco Li: small aria snippet for sparkline announcements: """ ▁▂▃▂▁
Announce only when change > 30%
""" Alex Soto: rendering tweak: add 1px dashed overlay for buckets where sampleRate < 15% so users don't mistake low-sample areas for zero traffic Jules Park: logging UX ticket: UX-99901 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-99901 for focus order + aria-live behavior Renee Cole: copy decisions recap: 1) Add thin throughput sparkline under p95 with hover tooltip. 2) Use 'Sampling granularity' label with Dynamic/Per-request/Windowed options and Dynamic default. 3) Colorblind-friendly palette + patterned overlay. 4) Stipple/dashed overlay for low-sample buckets. 5) Sparkline aria-live polite with >30% delta threshold. 6) Fix focus order in header. I'll update the mock and hand off to Eng tomorrow morning :rocket:
